name: Geekbot
description:
Run async standups, team updates, check-ins, polls, surveys, and get progress summaries in Slack and Microsoft Teams.

Geekbot is an assistant for Slack and Microsoft Teams that helps remote and hybrid teams automate standups, daily updates, team check-ins, status reports and any kind of polls or surveys (eg employee feedback, developer pulse, leadership trust and more).

Connect Geekbot to Claude to submit standup reports, answer daily check-ins, create polls and surveys, review team updates, read status reports and summarize weekly recaps.

Geekbot helps engineering managers, people/HR managers, team leads, and remote teams ask questions like 'Collect team blockers', 'Monitor employee engagement', 'Run a pulse survey', 'Submit my daily update' and more.

This feature requires a Geekbot paid plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Geekbot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Geekbot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.geekbot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Geekbot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Geekbot lists 17 MCP tools, including create_out_of_office, create_poll, create_standup, delete_out_of_office, delete_report, edit_out_of_office, edit_report, get_current_user, get_poll_participation, get_poll_results, get_standup_participation, and list_out_of_office.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Geekbot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Geekbot in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Geekbot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Geekbot is developed by Geekbot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
